theorems.name: Submission.p06_9e0f5043ff_sdp_clear_first_column
theorems.statement: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (m : ℕ) (B : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) R), (∀ i : Fin m, B 0 0 ∣ B i.succ 0) → ∃ U : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) R, IsUnit U ∧ (∀ j : Fin (m + 1), (U * B) 0 j = B 0 j) ∧ (∀ i : Fin m, (U * B) i.succ 0 = 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Choose divisibility witnesses a(i), and put them below the first entry of column zero in a matrix N with all other entries zero. Its zeroth row vanishes, so N² = 0. Thus U = 1 − N has two-sided inverse 1 + N. Multiplication preserves row zero and subtracts a(i) times that row from row i.succ, clearing the required entries. The construction also covers m = 0 and zero pivots.
